notes: Real data = Sun/Earth azimuth-elevation from JPL Horizons and terrain horizons from Moon Trek LOLA DEMs, precomputed by the data engine (data/sites/). Every tool evaluates the exact requested UTC interval: each hourly sample holds until the next one (sample-and-hold), the first and last are clipped to the mission, and durations, shares and means are weighted by the time each sample represents. Shares are of the whole mission unless marked as over known time.

Sunlit = any part of the solar disk above the local terrain horizon. Earth visible = Earth's centre above the terrain horizon. This is geometric line of sight only; it does not guarantee a working radio link (antenna pointing, ground-station schedules and link budget are not modelled).

Viability (PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN, score, violations) and the ranking come from the team's canonical viability engine. Only PASS scenarios are ranked, and only against scenarios with the same data basis, requirements and mission duration. A missing score is never treated as 0.
